title: Local Chandra 2 post-Nemotron capability panel
question: What additional PDF capabilities does Chandra OCR 2 offer after the retained Nemotron triple pass under Docling 2.148.0?
method: Pin and run official BF16 Chandra 2 on frozen PDF pages, authored enhancement controls and exact original-pixel crops. Compare the outputs against source and retained arms, then trace native replay, current projection, grammar and scoped baseline Reader use.
commands: .venv/bin/python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-08_chandra-post-nemotron/probe.py PDF OUTPUT --artifacts ARTIFACTS [selected pages and images in evidence README]
uv run ci source inspect RUN --producing-task TASK --product PRODUCT --native-digest DIGEST --native-view formula --pointer POINTER --json

agents.separation: Read-only source and live output assessment
Authored control source truth and checked novel live outputs

outputs.role: Frozen whole-book panel and source expectations
Independent source truth and hashes for authored inputs
Effective local versions and preset options
Twenty live request dispositions with exact raw HTML
Source page, render and reversible crop frames
Native items, replay summaries and actual application projection
Paired parser, completion and serialization controls
Identical content summaries for 21 retained requests
Incumbent exact Reader records and Chandra projection and grammar results
Offline snapshot refusal before successful explicit artifact selection

results.name: Live conversions returned
results.note: 12 pages, five authored supplements and three crops. All execution statuses were success and stop reasons unspecified.

results.name: Retained Nemotron response summaries matching across parsers
Source-confirmed directed edges on the authored diagram
Complete p416 matrix strings accepted by current grammar

conclusion: Attributed visual inspection and selected tables, figure descriptions, diagram edges and molecular metadata are supported by bounded live evidence. Typed promotion, generalization and upstream-only upgrade qualification remain separate. Existing projection can mix picture child interpretations into prose, and complete matrix strings still require a usable consumer reading.
